title: 13-year-old Corbell hears Knapp's Lazar interview on the radio

tellings.quote: I've said this before, you know, I heard George Knapp's voice interviewing a guy named Bob Lazar on the radio.

plain: The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell says that around 1990, at 13 years old, he heard the journalist George Knapp interviewing a man named Bob Lazar on the radio. Corbell tells it as his own memory, "I heard George Knapp's voice interviewing a guy named Bob Lazar on the radio," and gives it as the moment that started his lifelong interest in UFOs and his later work with both men.
